ANSWER:

**Entry & dispatch** (`pkg/okf/mcp.go`)
- `RunMCPServerIO` (line ~89) — reads newline-delimited JSON-RPC from stdin and calls `handleRequest`.
- `handleRequest` (line ~205) — routes `tools/call` to `handleToolCall`.
- `handleToolCall` → `case "okf_create":` (lines ~409, ~578) — extracts and validates all arguments: concept_id (format via `ValidateConceptID`), type, title, description (≤1000 bytes), body (≤1 MB), status (`draft`/`stable`/`deprecated`), tags (≤100 items). Builds a `*Concept` and calls `SaveConcept`.

**ID validation** (`pkg/okf/mutate.go`)
- `ValidateConceptID` (line ~152) — rejects control chars, bidi overrides, `..` traversal, hidden-dir components, reserved names (`index`, `log`, `AGENTS`), absolute paths, and depth > max.

**Persistence entry & locking** (`pkg/okf/mutate.go`, `pkg/okf/lock.go`)
- `SaveConcept` (line ~459) — re-validates the concept ID, calls `resolveInBundle` (symlink-safe path confinement), then calls `WithBundleLock`.
- `WithBundleLock` / `acquireFileLock` (`pkg/okf/lock.go` lines ~39, ~62) — **file-based cross-process exclusive lock** on `<bundleDir>/.okf-write.lock` via `os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY` in a spin loop (exponential back-off, 10 s timeout, 30 s stale-lock eviction). No `sync.Mutex` is used for concept writes.

**Locked write sequence** (`pkg/okf/mutate.go`)
- `saveConceptLocked` (line ~476) — inside the lock: re-validates path, checks `ensureNoForgedHumanVerification` (provenance guard), runs an optimistic CAS hash check for concurrent-modification detection, stamps `Generated` metadata, calls `sanitizeConceptMetadata` (rejects frontmatter-smuggling patterns), calls `SerializeConcept` (`pkg/okf/parser.go:533`) to render YAML frontmatter + Markdown, then calls `atomicWriteFile`.

**Final disk write** (`pkg/okf/mutate.go`)
- `atomicWriteFile` (line ~32) — crash-safe atomic replace: `os.MkdirAll` → `os.CreateTemp` (temp file in the same directory) → `tmpFile.Write` → `tmpFile.Sync` (fsync) → `tmpFile.Close` → `os.Chmod` → **`os.Rename`** (atomic replace on POSIX; best-effort on Windows).

CONFIDENCE: high
